# Luxillia Brown Magnetic Eyelashes with Eyeliner Kit

## Natural Brown Lashes for Everyday Definition
Enhance your eyes with brown magnetic lashes that complement your natural color. Ultra-thin 0.2 mm fibers add balanced length and volume that blend with your own lashes, so you get a soft, defined look.

## Magnetic Liner for Easy Application
Apply the waterproof liquid eyeliner, let it dry, then press the lash strip into place. Micro-magnetic particles in the liner help the lashes sit along your lash line, so you can skip the glue and get ready faster.

## Value for Repeat Wear
Each kit includes 50% extra liner, enough for up to five sets of lashes. A free applicator and brush help you place every lash with precision, and the reusable lashes let you refresh your look again and again.

## Cruelty-Free and Vegan
Grade A synthetic silk replaces mink in every lash, so you can enhance your look without supporting animal cruelty. The magnetic liner is made in the USA and lab tested for safety.

## Shop With Confidence
Try the set with a one-year satisfaction guarantee. If you're not happy for any reason within a year of purchase, we'll refund you.

Bring out your natural beauty. Add the Luxillia Brown Magnetic Eyelashes Kit to your cart today.
